migrationLockdown.heroSubtitle: This device is locked to preserve the integrity of your encrypted conversations.
migrationLockdown.step1: Transfer the .ghostrbk file to your new device.
migrationLockdown.step2: Install Ghostr and choose "Restore from backup".
migrationLockdown.step3: Once the migration is complete, come back here and wipe this device.
migrationLockdown.footer: No messages can be sent or received on this device while it's frozen.
migrationLockdown.wipeSubtitle: This action irreversibly erases all data on this device.
migrationLockdown.wipeIrreversibleBody: All messages, keys and settings will be deleted. ONLY do this AFTER you have successfully restored on your new device.
migrationLockdown.cancelSubtitle: This device will resume normal operation.
migrationLockdown.cancelDangerBody: ONLY cancel if you have NOT yet completed the import on the new device. Otherwise, both devices will send incompatible messages and some conversations will break.
migrationLockdown.reShareDesc: Recover the .ghostrbk file if you haven't saved it yet
migrationLockdown.fileLostNote: The backup file is no longer available on this device. If you've already transferred it to the new device, you can safely wipe this device.
migrationLockdown.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device
